title: Gnarly zone connections
description: Building-level links between nodes in different zones. Elevator links change floors and are weighted by a boarding cost plus a per-story cost. Continuation links join adjacent scans on the same floor without representing a door and have A* weight 1. Connections are bidirectional.

kind.description: How the zones meet. Omitted in legacy files.

zoneId.description: Zone whose building.json contains the node.

nodeId.description: Node id in that zone's building.json, such as elevator-east or zone-end.
